bullets.text: Minister Kumar.R arrived at the home of VS Babu before his body arrived.
Relatives of a deceased senior citizen protested in Thiruttani after she died from electric shock caused by a refrigerator.
DRI officials seized crores worth of heroin hidden in ice cream carts in Madhavaram, prompting strong police action.
An electric shock incident during a mourning event in Tiruttani resulted in one death and six injuries.
The Madras High Court dismissed petitions seeking approval for construction near the Pallikaranai marshland, upholding environmental protection.
Chennai transmission substation upgrades are delayed, putting summer power supply at risk.
Police conducted drug raids in the OMR and ECR areas, arresting five women with pills.
Police in Avadi arrested three individuals for usurping land worth Rs 2 crore using forged legal heir certificates.
About 800 ducks died near Uthukottai due to a mysterious disease, and samples were sent for lab testing.
Police patrolling in Gummidipoondi foiled an attempted ATM burglary, leading to an arrest and ongoing investigation.
The Tamil Nadu Housing Board is exploring a co-working model to offer startup office spaces in commercial properties.
PFRDA Chairperson S Ramann urged MeitY to establish a centralised regulatory framework for AI safeguards.
The Digital India BHASHINI Division showcased its voice-first AI and multilingual capabilities at Dakshin 2026.
DMK leader MK Stalin criticised the government over major drug seizures in Chennai.
The passing of TVK legislator VS Babu has prompted a forthcoming by-election in the Kolathur constituency.
BJP Tamil Nadu released an AI-generated video mocking CM Vijay and the TVK government.
The Tamil Nadu government issued an order allocating Rs 1.60 crore for yoga and naturopathy health programs for school students across 100 unions.
